_comments.model_type: Selects the PolarMACE calculator architecture used by this checkpoint.
_comments.instructions: Contains options interpreted by the i-PI MACE wrapper. FFDielectric supplies the field at run time, so no ensemble key is needed.
_comments.compute_BEC: Computes Born effective charges and the proper piezoelectric tensor for applying the field in i-PI.
_comments.ignore: Skips copying unused optional model outputs from the device to CPU.
